description: An HR business partner must finalize a workable collaboration plan for Dana and Eli after repeated tension during project handoffs, including the operating rules, repair process, and review period.

shared_context.S1: Dana and Eli must continue exchanging project handoffs for the next quarter.
shared_context.S2: Their last three handoffs included tense exchanges about incomplete context and response expectations.
shared_context.S3: Marisol is responsible for finalizing the workplace response and documenting the operating plan.
shared_context.S4: As part of the mediation routine, Marisol asks each participant to state what arrangement would make the ongoing collaboration workable, and each participant must separately identify any prior commitment or concrete participation requirement that should be recorded before Marisol closes the plan.

PF1.text: Six weeks ago, Dana and Eli informally agreed to use a shared written handoff template and respond within 48 hours. Dana's concrete recommendation for the new documented operating plan is to use that arrangement for exactly six weeks, not for the entire next quarter; she kept the agreement in her notes because neither of them formally documented it with Marisol.

PF2.text: Unscheduled one-to-one confrontations with Dana trigger significant anxiety for Eli. Eli needs every repair conversation to be facilitated by Marisol and cannot participate in an unfacilitated one-to-one repair conversation; every facilitated repair conversation must be scheduled with at least 24 hours' notice. He has not raised this with Marisol because he feared it would sound like a refusal to collaborate.

acceptance_conditions: The response must be a structured collaboration reset.
Dana and Eli must use a shared written handoff template.
The handoff response window must be 48 hours.
The new documented operating arrangement must last exactly six weeks.
Unscheduled one-to-one confrontations between Dana and Eli must not be allowed.
Every repair conversation must be facilitated by Marisol.
Every facilitated repair conversation must provide at least 24 hours' notice.
A written handoff commitment must be logged.
A facilitated repair commitment must be logged.

content_checks.C2: (('shared' in decisions.get('handoff_format', '') or 'Shared' in decisions.get('handoff_format', '')) and ('written' in decisions.get('handoff_format', '') or 'Written' in decisions.get('handoff_format', '')) and ('template' in decisions.get('handoff_format', '') or 'Template' in decisions.get('handoff_format', '')))
content_checks.C8: any(c.get('type') in ['formalize_handoff_agreement', 'handoff_protocol', 'handoff_template'] or (('written' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Written' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('handoff' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Handoff' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('template' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Template' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and any(c.get('type') in ['repair_conversation_notice', 'no_unscheduled_one_on_ones', 'notice_requirement'] or (('facilitated' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Facilitated' in c.get('detail', '')) and ('repair' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Repair' in c.get('detail', ''))) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Dana's prior agreement fixes the handoff format as a shared written template, fixes the response window at exactly 48 hours, fixes the new operating period at exactly six weeks rather than the full quarter, and requires a written handoff commitment.

Eli's anxiety response requires all repair conversations to be facilitated, prohibits unscheduled one-to-one confrontations, fixes the notice period at at least 24 hours, and requires the settlement to record that facilitated repair requirement.
